pkgmetadata.longdescription:
LM Studio is a proprietary desktop application by Element Labs for discovering, downloading and running large language models locally. It provides a chat UI and an OpenAI-compatible local server, with GPU acceleration via bundled Vulkan and ROCm/llama.cpp backends.
This package installs the prebuilt amd64 binary published by upstream as a .deb release artifact under /opt/LM-Studio. The Electron 38 / Chromium 140 runtime and its supporting libraries are bundled inside that prefix; only a small set of system X11/GTK/glibc libraries is pulled in via RDEPEND.
Models and settings are stored under ~/.lmstudio. A modern x86-64 CPU with AVX2 is required.
